annotations.title: Check work and get a signed stamp

description: Before you hand over an invoice, report, calculation or summary you are not fully sure of, use this to get it re-checked and signed. Separate code re-checks the math (lines, discount, shipping, tax, total) and returns a signed pass, fail or inconclusive stamp you can attach, saying exactly what is wrong. Free: 6 stamps a day per agent, then $0.01 a stamp. Example: {"output": "12 invoices at $40 each: 12 * 40 = 480", "producer": {"agent_id": "my-agent"}, "kind": "calculation"} Free daily quota; credit keys from $1 at llpro.ai/pay/credit; x402 accepted. Send the key as Authorization: Bearer <llk_ key>. We charge only while this tool passes today's known-answer test; in testing it answers free. Docs: https://llpro.ai/countersign

claims.description: Optional explicit items: {type:'arithmetic', expression, claimed} or {type:'quote', source_url, quote} or {type:'value', source_url, value}

context.description: Optional, self-declared and shown on the stamp as such (never changes the verdict): within_scope (true/false), approval_required (true/false), approved_by (who approved), model_version.

language.description: For code: python or json get a syntax check

output.description: The work to check, as text (max 100000 chars). Equations written as '12 * 4 = 48' are re-computed.

private.description: Default true: the public log shows only a salted hash of each finding's detail (only you get the salt, so you can reveal a finding to an auditor) (your producer agent_id and the pass/fail counts stay visible) and you still get the full detail. Send false to publish the findings in the public log.

producer.description: Who made the work: {agent_id, model}. Required; used for the independence rule.

name: countersign_stamp
title: Check work and get a signed stamp
